description.raw: '''Passive:''' '''Malzahar''' generates a stack of ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' when he casts another [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|ability]], up to a maximum of 2.
description.text: Passive: Malzahar generates a stack of Zz'Rot Swarm when he casts another ability, up to a maximum of 2.

description2.raw: '''Active:''' '''Malzahar''' consumes all ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stacks and, after a 0.5-second delay, summons a [[File:VoidlingSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Voidling|An icon representing Voidling]] [[Voidling]] at the target location. Additional ''Voidlings'' are then summoned for each ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stack consumed, with each ''Voidling'' being summoned 0.5 seconds after the previous one.
description2.text: Active: Malzahar consumes all Zz'Rot Swarm stacks and, after a 0.5-second delay, summons a Voidling at the target location. Additional Voidlings are then summoned for each Zz'Rot Swarm stack consumed, with each Voidling being summoned 0.5 seconds after the previous one.

description3.raw: ''Voidlings'' deal magic damage with their attacks, reduced by 50% against epic [[File:Monster icon.png|20px|link=Monster|An icon representing the keyword Monster]] [[:Monster|monsters]] and increased by 200% to enemy [[File:Minion icon.png|20px|link=Minion|An icon representing the keyword Minion]] [[:Minion|minions]] infected by ''[[File:Malzahar Malefic Visions.png|20xpx|border|link=Malzahar#Malefic Visions|An icon for Malzahar's ability Malefic Visions]] [[Malzahar#Malefic Visions|Malefic Visions]]''.
description3.text: Voidlings deal magic damage with their attacks, reduced by 50% against epic monsters and increased by 200% to enemy minions infected by Malefic Visions.

description4.text: See Pets for more details about Voidlings.

leveling3.raw:

leveling3.text: Magic Damage:5 – 64.5 (based on level) (+ 12 / 14 / 16 / 18 / 20) (+ 40% bonus AD) (+ 20% AP)Minion Damage:15 – 193.5 (based on level) (+ 36 / 42 / 48 / 54 / 60) (+ 120% bonus AD) (+ 60% AP)

notes.raw: * '''Malzahar''' loses all [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stacks]] upon [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|death]]. * ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stacks are gained per cast and not per ability activation. For example, if [[File:Malzahar Malefic Visions.png|20xpx|border|link=Malzahar#Malefic Visions|An icon for Malzahar's ability Malefic Visions]] [[Malzahar#Malefic Visions|Malefic Visions]] is cast and the ability cancels under certain circumstances, a ''Zz'Rot Swarm'' stack will still be granted despite the ability's failure to complete.
notes.text:
Malzahar loses all stacks upon death.
Zz'Rot Swarm stacks are gained per cast and not per ability activation. For example, if Malefic Visions is cast and the ability cancels under certain circumstances, a Zz'Rot Swarm stack will still be granted despite the ability's failure to complete.
